say:1:1430229401:0.text: Setti is our friend. She was a servant.
say:1:1430229401:0.source_cn: 赛特是我们的朋友，曾是个仆从。
say:1:1430229401:0.male: Setti is our friend. She was a servant.
say:1:1430229401:0.female: Setti is our friend. She was a servant.

say:2:1430229402:1.text: Setti accidentally stepped on his feet and lost her life for it!
say:2:1430229402:1.source_cn: 前阵子赛特不小心踩了他的脚，结果丢了性命！
say:2:1430229402:1.male: Setti accidentally stepped on his feet and lost her life for it!
say:2:1430229402:1.female: Setti accidentally stepped on his feet and lost her life for it!

say:4:1430229403:1.text: I was wrong! I'll pay my weight in gold! Just name your price!
say:4:1430229403:1.source_cn: 我错了，我愿意赔钱！我可以出一大笔钱赎罪！

say:6:1430229404:1.text: Silence! You don't feel remorse! You just fear the noose!
say:6:1430229404:1.source_cn: 给我闭嘴！你并不是知道错了，而是在害怕死亡而已。
